# Chain of Custody

In forensic work, a claim is only as good as the trail from the claim back to the artefact it came
from. Modelled in data, that means every assertion must resolve to a **document row**, and every
document row must carry enough to identify the original page.

## How it is built

In [[labour-fraud-analysis]], the `document` table carries a source path, a content hash, a
duplicate count and a document class. Three junction tables — document↔person, document↔company,
document↔worksite — record which parties each document touches. Nothing in the narrative is supposed
to exist without a row behind it.

> "no single date or number here is load-bearing without the underlying page."
> — labour-fraud-analysis-a-forensic-data-investigation/docs/investigation.md, 2026-07-11

That sentence is the whole discipline compressed. It says two things at once: the numbers are
evidence, and no individual number is *the* evidence — which is why the argument is built as
[[convergent-evidence]] rather than as a single decisive figure.

## Three mechanisms worth separating

- **Content hashing for deduplication.** The corpus folds ~2,456 originals down to 512 distinct
  records by content hash. This is an **ingestion step**, not an analytic finding — a scanned page
  filed three times is one document. Do not read it as duplicate-record fraud detection; no such
  analytic exists here.
- **Provenance junctions.** Because the document↔party links are tables rather than prose, "what does
  this claim rest on" is a query. This is where [[third-normal-form]] pays for itself.
- **Tiered reliability.** Claims are graded up front: official documents, single-source testimony, and
  inference. The tier travels with the claim, so a reader can discount without re-deriving.

## Data-quality errors are kept, not cleaned

The corpus contains extraction errors — wrong dates from OCR — and they are **preserved deliberately**
in both the private source and the synthetic derivative. Two reasons, both real: cleaning a value is
an unrecorded edit to evidence, and a dataset without the original's defects does not exercise the
same cleaning problems. See [[structure-preserving-anonymisation]] and
[[provenance-and-limits-stated-inline]].

## The limit of custody through an anonymiser

Once the corpus passes through the pipeline, the chain leads back to a **synthetic** document row,
and the link to the real page exists only in the git-ignored mapping. The published artefact is
therefore internally auditable and externally unverifiable — a deliberate trade, and one more reason
every page for this repo stays `publish: false`. See [[disclosure-gate]] and
[[synthesise-rather-than-redact]].
